sources.title: Steinberg quotients and Smith–Treumann localization
sources.scope: Main Theorems1.1/1.2 and7.6 require p good. Condition2.1 weight varsigma with simple-coroot pairings1, rho for semisimple simply connected; Gm-equivariance and pvarsigma-twisted rotation; auxiliary characteristic ell different from p. Unsigned total stalk-rank formula.
sources.conditional_mechanism: Page41 formal division from Cor5.9 (averaging indecomposable parity objects), commuting Grothendieck diagram Figure7.1/Theorem7.5, RW3 Smith image and character identities. Those essential geometric results were not all independently verified.
sources.not_claimed: No full56page proof audit, no complete original object-identification certification, no journal/refereeing or bad-prime status certificate.

sources.title: Decomposition of tensor products of modular irreducibles for SL2
sources.essential_statement: Lemma1.1a T(u)=L(u)=nabla(u)=Delta(u) for0<=u<=p-1;1.1b T(u) forp<=u<=2p-2 is uniserial with factors L(2p-2-u),L(u),L(2p-2-u), extension giving chi(u)+chi(2p-2-u). Atp3,u4 yields chi4+chi0. Lemma proof explicitly identifies nabla(r)=Sym^rE. Uniqueness of indecomposable tiltings stated p2.
sources.dependency_limit: Authenticated established-character cross-check and standard tilting input; not re-proving all Donkin/Jantzen foundations.

sources.title: On Certain Tilting Modules for SL2
sources.author: Samuel Martin
sources.essential_statement: Section1.1 identifies induced nabla(r)=Sym^rE, Weyl Delta(r)=nabla(r)*, tilting as both filtrations; unique indecomposable T(r); ordinary integer character in Z[x,x-1].
sources.dependency_limit: Only terminology/structural input needed; main elementary proof does not invoke direct-summand closure.
